'''Borga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] gladiator fighter who served under [[Fell Dargun]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> while at the [[Lady of Pain]]'s [[Lady of Pain's compound|compound]], Borga fought a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] in the gladiatorial pits. Borga entered the fight self-assured that he had a victory, but underestimated his opponent, and was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR:ABwtLoP" />
